title: Quantize in stages and on a grid
brief: Build residual vector quantization with its residual norms and prefix decoding, then finite scalar quantization with its mixed-radix index.
hints: In rvq_encode, keep a running residual: call nearest_codeword on it, add the codeword to the reconstruction, subtract it from the residual, and record np.linalg.norm(residual, axis=1).
rvq_decode needs no search: add codebooks[i][codes[:, i]] for each column i that codes has.
fsq_quantize is half * torch.tanh(z), then bounded + (torch.round(bounded) - bounded).detach() to pass the gradient straight through.
fsq_index multiplies the digits (z_hat + L // 2) by the basis [1, L0, L0 * L1, ...]. fsq_unindex divides by the basis with // and takes % L.
